subject: MAP: pre-close guardrails for token economics & prefetch assumptions
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amrita Patel <amrita.patel@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: pre-close cost validation and token economics checklist

Amrita — kicking off the MAP cost-readiness thread as requested. Attaching the initial simulation run we did for your expected traffic (attached: BH-sim-results.csv) and a draft MAP (MAP-v1.2.pdf). Highlights and asks below: 

- Baseline assumptions we used in the sim: 35% prefix cache hit (warm cache), median batch size 8, mean tokens per user session = 1,050, model variant gpt-3.7-std (quantized) at $25 / 1M tokens equivalent.
- Key sensitivity knobs: cache hit-rate (we tested 20/35/50%), batching latency SLO (targets: p95 < 180ms), and fallback model routing for cost spikes.
- Open questions we need you to confirm for MAP signoff:
  1) Is the 35% cache hit-rate reasonable given your session distribution?
  2) Do you require strict end-to-end p95 latency <120ms or is 180ms acceptable for initial pilot?
  3) Any procurement constraints on PO/term start dates that affect our capacity planning?

Next steps: if you confirm cache and latency targets we will lock the MAP cost appendix and run an expanded sim (prefetch/warmup scenarios) — should have results back in 48 hours. Proposed MAP close timeline in the doc assumes PO by Nov 20, trial Dedicated capacity by Dec 1.

Attachments: BH-sim-results.csv (summary + sample traffic), MAP-v1.2.pdf (draft MAP appendix)

Thanks,
David
---
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: pre-close cost validation and token economics checklist

Thanks David — received and reviewed the high-level numbers. A few quick notes: 

- Cache hit-rate: our logs show steady-state prefix reuse closer to ~30-38% for the pilot cohort; 35% is within expectations but we need to validate under ramp.
- Latency: clinical workflows require <150ms for the interactive path; we can tolerate 180ms on background workflows but would prefer the interactive p95 to be <=150ms.
- Procurement: target PO date Nov 20 is still our goal; legal wants the MAP appendix attached to the SOW. Procurement asked for a completed procurement-form.pdf — attaching their template.

Can we schedule a 30-min call Tue to walk the tradeoffs (cache warmup, batching vs cost) with engineering and FinOps? Prefer 10:00-11:00 PT.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: pre-close cost validation and token economics checklist

Internal summary and next actions (short):

- Action items I will own: update MAP appendix to explicitly show two scenarios (interactive SLO = 150ms, lenient SLO = 180ms), and include tokenized cost waterfall (tokens/user -> tokens/1k sessions -> tokens/1M).
- Simulation notes: original sim used median batch 8, but tail-cost scenarios were driven by spikes where continuous batching collapsed to micro-batches (1-2). We should include a conservative tail-case in the appendix (effective tokens per 1k requests increases by ~18%).
- Cache: confirm we model both warm-cache (35%) and cold-cache ramp (start at 10% then warm to 35% over first 12k sessions). That will affect month-one gross cost 8-12%.

I'll produce MAP-v1.3.pdf with the two scenario tables and a short reconciliation sheet (sim-checks.xlsx) by Thu EOD. Priyom — can you run a quick sensitivity sim that toggles batch-size median 8 vs 12 and cache 25/35/50 so we can show delta to price per MAU? Target to have internal signoff by Thu so we can share updated MAP with Amrita on Fri.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Solutions Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: pre-close cost validation and token economics checklist

Amrita / team — following our internal sims and Marissa's updates, this is the agreed cost gating and near-term timeline we recommend including in the MAP appendix. Please see the short bullets and attached MAP-v1.3.pdf + sim-checks.xlsx.

Summary of finalized gating numbers (pilot):
- Cache: baseline steady-state prefix hit-rate = 35% (cold ramp modeled over first 12k sessions).
- Batching: median batch size 8 (aggressive prefetch option exists; shows cost savings but increases p95 by ~30ms).
- Tokens per active session: conservative = 1,000; expected = 1,200; we will model both in the appendix.
- Unit pricing equivalent used in model: $25 / 1M tokens (quantized inference path).
- Pilot cost sensitivity: under baseline the monthly token spend estimate = ~$9.5k (expected) vs ~$11.6k (conservative cold-ramp + smaller batches).

Operational asks to lock MAP:
1) BlueHarbor to confirm interactive p95 requirement. If <=150ms we recommend a smaller batch floor (8) + optimistic cache warm plan.
2) Sign the MAP appendix and procurement form (linked DocuSign) by Nov 20 to hit Dec 1 Dedicated trial date.

Timeline/next steps:
- Today: MAP-v1.3 and sim-checks uploaded (attached).
- Fri 11/6: internal signoff & send updated MAP to BlueHarbor.
- 11/9-11/13: BlueHarbor review & final clarifying Qs.
- 11/20: Target PO execution.
- 12/01: Trial Dedicated capacity onboarding.

Attachments: MAP-v1.3.pdf, sim-checks.xlsx
